title: M3.6: Slack identity linking
description:
Member links a Slack user via Sign in with Slack from the web app; the provider user id is stored against the member; owner can confirm an email-match suggestion. Unlink and member removal take effect at the next message.

Acceptance criteria:
- Only the member who completes the sign-in gets linked; a different Slack user cannot claim the link
- Removed members' Slack messages are quarantined
- Email match alone never links without owner confirmation

Gherkin: features/slack_identity_linking.feature

Depends on: M3.3, M2.1

Contract: the External channels contract (initiative description; draft docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.draft.md).

Process: Gherkin first (AGENTS.md outside-in). Write the named feature, add it to features/cucumber-features.txt, implement steps in conversation/features-support/steps/, then production code. Vitest only for pure helpers. Both cucumber-js and vitest must pass. No emojis, no compatibility forks, tenant_id on every item, strangers get 404. Product PR into develop with sub-agent review.
